description: Build a small Go CLI command at `swarm-manager image generate` that agents shell out to instead of calling the OpenAI API directly. Responsibilities: (1) read EnableImageGeneration setting and short-circuit if off, (2) load OpenAI key from secrets, (3) call gpt-image-2 with prompt + optional reference image paths + input_fidelity flag, (4) write the generated PNG to a predictable path and emit its URL/path to stdout, (5) log the call for cost tracking. This is the single enforcement point for the toggle — skills invoke this helper only, never the raw HTTP API. Automated tests cover the toggle-off short-circuit, key-missing error, and a mocked successful-call path.
name: swarm-manager-image-cli-helper
title: Add swarm-manager image generate CLI helper
